stills.name: sheet_cheel
stills.prompt: CHARACTER MODEL SHEET on a plain warm cream background: one single character in three views — full body side profile, full body front, and a head close-up. The character is चालाक चील, a great cut-paper kite/eagle and the villain of a preschool papercraft show. Design: much larger than any dragon child, layered dark umber and charcoal-brown paper feathers with cold slate-grey edges, a long cruel hooked golden beak, and huge half-lidded amber eyes that look calm and amused rather than angry — the face of someone enjoying a game she has already won. Long sharp folded wings that read as blades when closed, heavy scaled talons, and a crest of three swept-back feathers. Elegant, still, patient, vain — a queen of the sky. Papercraft construction with visible paper edges and folds, matched to the show's art style, non-photorealistic. Clean neutral lighting, no scene, no background elements.
